title: Recover the Stash
description: An emergency incident report disappeared from the working tree after it was stashed.
mission: Find the stash and restore incident-report.txt into the working tree.
success: The incident report has been restored from the stash.
solution: git stash apply or git stash pop

lesson.what_happened: Git stored the uncommitted file in a stash instead of deleting it.
lesson.be_careful: pop removes a stash only after a successful application.

hints: Show the stash contents before applying it.
Use git stash apply or git stash pop.

ja.title: Stashから復旧
